out_of_hospital_midwife.kit_ordering: Out-of-hospital providers order newborn screening collection cards through the Alabama Department of Public Health (ADPH) Bureau of Clinical Laboratories. Supplies are requested via the ADPH Newborn Screening supply ordering process.
out_of_hospital_midwife.submission_deadline: Blood specimen collected 24-48 hours of age; repeat screen required if first collected before 24 hours.
out_of_hospital_midwife.specimen_tracking: Results returned to the ordering provider; parents receive results from their provider. Tracking via the ADPH Newborn Screening portal.

hearing_screening.program_name: Alabama Early Hearing Detection and Intervention (EHDI)
hearing_screening.out_of_hospital_path: For home/birth-center births, the midwife performs or arranges the newborn hearing screen and documents results; refusal is documented in writing in the medical record per ÃÂÃÂ§ 22-20-3.

cchd_screening.out_of_hospital_performer: The attending midwife or physician performs pulse oximetry (CCHD) in the out-of-hospital setting and documents it; refusal documented per Ala. Code 22-20-3.

erythromycin_eye_ointment.statute: Ala. Admin. Code 420-4-1 (Hospital Rules, newborn prophylaxis) / ÃÂÃÂ§ 22-20-3
erythromycin_eye_ointment.waiver: Prophylactic eye treatment is mandatory; a parent may refuse on religious grounds and the facility documents the refusal in the medical record. Alabama issues the refusal/waiver through the facility, not as a public state form.
erythromycin_eye_ointment.note: Approved prophylactic (e.g., erythromycin) applied to each eye shortly after birth to prevent ophthalmia neonatorum.

vitamin_k.note: Alabama does not mandate vitamin K; parental choice of oral, intramuscular shot, or decline, documented in the birth record.

hepatitis_b_vaccine.note: Birth dose reported to ImmPRINT by birthing facilities; infants born to HBsAg-positive mothers are referred for Hepatitis B case management.

gestational_diabetes.midwife_role: Licensed midwives in Alabama provide gestational diabetes screening/counseling in prenatal care and refer for diagnostic testing when indicated.
gestational_diabetes.note: Prenatal informed-choice item; no state newborn-screening form.

group_b_strep.midwife_role: Licensed midwives offer GBS screening in late pregnancy and arrange intrapartum prophylaxis per protocol for out-of-hospital births when indicated.
group_b_strep.note: Prenatal informed-choice item; no state newborn-screening form.
